ev.q: W.I.T.C.H. is a French-American animated television series
who have respective magical powers over the classical elements
describing it as an exciting fantasy story with a diverse cast
centered around the trials of friendship and girlhood
based on the Italian comic book series of the same name
A highly imaginative show with lots of lore and world-building
while balancing between action, comedy, and drama
praised the opening song and animation
